text:
alex: Heads up — customer reported redeem flow shows success in the portal and they got the confirmation email but their org usage/balance is still 0.
alex: Org: acme-dev (org_id: org_34b2). Subaccount: acme-dev:feature-team (sub_id: sub_9f1). Promo: TRIAL-ACME-2026. Claim ID: claim_0a7c. Portal shows green check and 'Credits applied'.
alex: Screenshot & audit email attached: https://files.redwood/acme/claim_0a7c.png
maya: thanks — can you paste the webhook / ledger logs? first guess is a mapping mismatch between subaccount and billing_profile.
support-bot: partner-webhook handler: 2026-03-15T18:12:03Z POST /callbacks/redeem 200 OK -> {"claim_id":"claim_0a7c","org_id":"org_34b2","sub_account":"sub_9f1","amount":5000}
support-bot: internal queue: enqueue apply-credit job job_8812 -> acknowledged
alex: here's the minimal repro I used from the portal flow (copied):
alex: ```
POST /v1/credits/apply
{
  "claim_id": "claim_0a7c",
  "org_id": "org_34b2",
  "sub_id": "sub_9f1",
  "amount": 5000
}
```
alex: and the worker log when processing job_8812:
alex: ```
[2026-03-15T18:12:04Z] job_8812 START processing claim_0a7c
[2026-03-15T18:12:04Z] resolve_org(org_34b2) -> org_pk=12345
[2026-03-15T18:12:04Z] lookup_billing_profile(org_pk=12345, sub_id=sub_9f1) -> billing_profile_id=null
[2026-03-15T18:12:04Z] apply_credit_to_billing_profile(null) -> SKIP (no billing_profile)
[2026-03-15T18:12:04Z] mark_claim_seen(claim_0a7c) -> portal shows success
[2026-03-15T18:12:04Z] job_8812 DONE
```
maya: that log line is the smoking gun — handler marked the claim as seen even when no billing_profile found. we should not ack until credit write completes.
maya: billing @billing can you confirm whether sub_9f1 has a billing_profile? if not, is there a default mapping for subaccounts?
billing: ran quick check against billing service. query:
billing: ```sql
SELECT id, org_id, sub_id, billing_profile_id FROM subaccount_mappings WHERE sub_id = 'sub_9f1';
```
billing: result -> row exists but billing_profile_id is NULL. created_at: 2023-09-02. notes: migrated from legacy onboarding.
billing: reason: prior migration left a few subaccounts unlinked; usually the platform falls back to org-level billing_profile, but apply path expects billing_profile_id on the sub row for direct writes.
sre-jordan: can you share the worker code path? maybe it uses sub-specific write and bails if null. if portal marked success that means UI flow doesn't check the same condition.
alex: worker snippet used by the job (from logs): ```
if mapping.billing_profile_id:
  ledger.write(billing_profile_id, amount)
else:
  log.info('no billing_profile, skipping')
  mark_claim_seen()
```
alex: that's the bug pattern — mark_claim_seen happens in else.
maya: ok, immediate remediation: 1) update worker to not mark claim seen on skip and instead put the job into a retry queue; 2) backfill for affected claims.
eng-infra: will cut a hotfix to change behavior to defensive mode (don't ack before ledger write). assigning ENG ticket: ENG-5231.
eng-infra: deploying hotfix to staging now.
support-bot: hotfix deploy started at 2026-03-15T18:32:10Z -> canary -> 3 pods
billing: we'll run a join to find all claims processed where billing_profile_id was null and claim marked seen within the same second. query I'm running:
billing: ```sql
SELECT c.claim_id, c.org_id, c.sub_id, c.processed_at
FROM claim_events c
LEFT JOIN subaccount_mappings s ON c.sub_id = s.sub_id
WHERE s.billing_profile_id IS NULL AND c.status = 'seen' AND c.processed_at BETWEEN '2026-03-15 18:00:00' AND '2026-03-15 19:00:00';
```
billing: found 7 claims including claim_0a7c -> collecting list and will enqueue backfill job.
billing: enqueued backfill job BACKFILL-119 to apply credits to org level where needed and populate mapping.
billing: contact with cust: support ticket #SUP-90812 created, customer notified that we found the issue and will apply credits within 1 hour. :white_check_mark:
alex: thanks. can we also add a guard in the portal UI so it shows "pending ledger write" instead of success while job outstanding? a UX mismatch caused the customer alarm.
maya: good call — filed UX follow-up: UX-1147.
eng-infra: hotfix rolled to prod at 2026-03-15T18:41:02Z. patch: DO NOT mark_claim_seen until ledger.write returns success. also added exponential retry for missing billing_profile with requeue after 5m.
eng-infra: backfill ran and applied credits for the 7 affected claims at 2026-03-15T18:52:10Z. ledger entries generated and usage updated.
alex: confirmed with customer — balance now shows 5000 credits applied. customer replied "Thanks, looks good now".
billing: closing internal incident. created follow-ups: Migrate-missing-subaccounts job (BILL-204) and UI state fix (UX-1147).
maya: closing thread, will update KB article about 'claim seen' semantics and how to troubleshoot ledger misses.
alex: thx all :pray:
